text.p: Amerada Hess Corp said the exploratory well drilled on the northern half of Garden Banks Block 215 was "encouraging."

Hess is operator of the well in 1,500 feet of water 117 miles southwest of Morgan City, La. The company has a 37.50 percent interest, as does the Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Offshore Inc, while Oryx Energy owns 25 percent.
Hess said the Garden Banks 215 4 well was drilled to 21,692 feet and encountered subsalt hydrocarbon bearing reservoir sands.
The well is located about four miles northwest of the development side for Hess' Baldpate Project on Garden Banks Block 160.
The company said it intends to drill another well on the north half of Block 215 during the third quarter to confirm the extent of "this potential reserve addition."
